title: AI CV Creator & ATS Optimization Studio
tagline: Dual-LLM Resume Tailoring & Hybrid ATS Gap Analysis Studio
description: Engineered an end-to-end local AI pipeline using dual open-source LLMs (Gemma 2B for entity extraction and Llama 3.2 3B for executive tailoring). Features a hybrid ATS scoring engine (70% deterministic token overlap with regex word-boundary matching + 30% LLM qualitative auditing), dual synthesis modes (strict zero-hallucination vs. creative tailoring with locked employer history), single-column ATS Word/Markdown document generation, and an interactive desktop/web Flet studio with live side-by-side resume comparison.
